groups.name: participation chart
groups.note: Rusher count, pressure flag, coverage, box count and personnel come from the participation file. FTN holds a second rusher and box count; it equals the participation count on 99.9% of plays in 2023 and 2024 (one chart) and on 77% (rushers) and 55% (box) in 2022 (chartChecks), so no second collection is counted.

groups.name: FTN chart
groups.note: Play action and motion come only from the FTN file. Plays the FTN file lacks count as neither (ftnMissing in chartChecks).
